author: SickProdigy
description: Monitor Minecraft Java and Bedrock servers and publish official game updates.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild-owned public Minecraft connection settings, bounded cached status data, visibility settings, and announcement configuration. It does not store linked game identities or administrative credentials.
install_msg: Add a server with `[p]minecraftset add <name> <java|bedrock> <host> [port]`, or configure official releases with `[p]minecraftset updates channel <channel>` and `[p]minecraftset updates start`.
short: Minecraft server status and official updates
